release_title: Qwen3.8-Max：编程与办公，全面跃升（A New Bar for Coding and Cowork）

models.name: Qwen3.8-Max
models.variant: 2.4T total / 95B active; built on Qwen 3.5 architecture; first open-weights Qwen-Max-tier model (weights promised the following week)
models.capability_summary: 通义将 Qwen3.8-Max 定位为当前 Qwen 家族最强大的模型，基于 Qwen 3.5 架构将参数规模扩展至 2.4 万亿（激活参数 95B），在编程、办公、科研与长周期任务上全面提升，并成为首个开源权重的 Qwen-Max 级模型（权重于下周发布）。已收录评测覆盖智能体编码与办公、多模态理解与操作、视频理解及长上下文等领域，Terminal-Bench 2.1 86.6、PaperBench 93。

Table 1 protocol footnotes (1-20) recorded: Fable5 may include fallback; Terminal Bench 2.1 = Claude Code avg@10, 5h timeout, max_tokens 131,072 (competitor cells = best published, Opus4.8/Fable5 via Artificial Analysis Terminus 2, GPT-5.6 Sol via Codex); SWE-bench Pro = Claude Code temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / 256K context on a corrected task set with all baselines re-run; DeepSWE 1.1 = best of Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent (Qwen best on Claude Code); NL2Repo-Bench = Claude Code with pip download/install + git clone blocked as anti-reward-hacking; FrontierSWE = Claude Code, competitor MEAN@5 from the official leaderboard as of 2026-08-03 with dominance recomputed by the official script; MLS-Bench-Lite = Claude Code 5h timeout max_tokens 131,072, competitors from official leaderboard; PaperBench = BasicAgent Code-Dev judged by Claude Opus 4.6, mean of 3 runs (12h each); AndroidBench = 95-task public subset avg@3; QwenSWEBench = internal, Claude Code avg@3, 8h timeout, max_tokens 32,768, temp 1.0, 256K; QwenQoderBench = internal avg@5, 6h, same caps; QwenReactBench = internal bilingual React build, auto render + multimodal judge, BT/Elo; QwenSVGBench = internal bilingual SVG, same scoring; SkillsBench = public v1.1, 87 tasks, mean of 3 runs (Opus4.8/Fable5 on Claude Code, GPT-5.6 Sol on Codex, Qwen on OpenCode); Automation-Bench = 600-task public subset; WideSearch = mean item-F1 over 4 runs (competitors Claude Code, our model Qwen-Agent); $OneMillion-Bench and PLawBench judged by gemini-3.1-pro-preview. API config: reasoning_effort low/medium/xhigh (default xhigh), preserve_thinking on by default. Long-horizon demos with disclosed numbers: 16-day autonomous oh-my-cli repo (265 commits / 127 PRs / 151 issues, full trace public at github.com/qwen-code-dev-bot/oh-my-cli); 125-hour paper reproduction + self-evolution on AIME24 (reproduced method 49.58%, self-evolved 52.29% = +2.71, 18 ideas over 4 exploration rounds); WWW2025 multimodal dialogue intent challenge: accuracy 0.60 -> 0.853 over 45 submissions in 24h, beating 458 of 526 human teams (87%). RL system disclosed: joint scaling of environments x compute across QwenWork/Claude Code/Codex/OpenClaw/Hermes harnesses; unified reward system (execution-based checks + rubric on text/rendered-visual output + agentic checks); online data balancer per batch.
